candidate_relations.reason: MIS-C is a distinct diagnostic entity from Kawasaki disease. While there is clinical overlap and MIS-C can present with KD-like features, the reference diagnosis is Kawasaki disease. MIS-C requires confirmed or probable SARS-CoV-2 infection and typically presents with more severe multisystem involvement; here SARS-CoV-2 PCR is negative and the clinical picture aligns more closely with classic KD. Asserting MIS-C conflicts with the reference.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Different diagnostic entity with overlapping features but distinct criteria and etiology
